description:
We are SPACE BOYS, a team from Shivamogga, India, creating an interactive space-learning experience for young explorers. Our project, Junior Astronaut Mission Trainer, helps students explore the choices behind a space mission through hands-on gameplay—from building a rocket to keeping a lunar outpost supplied and its crew safe.

Our goal is to make space science engaging, understandable, and fun, encouraging students to experiment, learn from mistakes, and try again.
